name: What types of materials are commonly used for slip-resistant shower floors?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are commonly used for slip-resistant shower floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for slip-resistant shower floors include textured porcelain or ceramic tiles with a high Coefficient of Friction (COF) rating, natural stone with a honed or sandblasted finish, and engineered materials like composite resins. Some homeowners also opt for acrylic or fiberglass shower pans with integrated non-slip surfaces. Each material offers varying levels of slip resistance, durability, and aesthetic appeal, suitable for different design preferences and budgets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials like textured porcelain, honed natural stone, and composite resins are popular for slip-resistant shower floors.
